answer: Sybil defence starts where capital stops working. Holding tokens buys no standing; only graded work on the ripple accrues. Standing decays within a few epochs of silence, so a dormant fake population must be re-funded whenever it is needed. That converts its vault from a permanent asset into a stock of perishable work, held at a recurring cost. An attacker's arithmetic: N identities cost N independent generations per epoch forever, plus N chances of a failed grade, and the garden is shared, not multiplied. Seal 20jj2.
